ja: 北オブシディアシャッター解除

key: TITANIA: Another down, and one scampered off to the east exit.
en: TITANIA: Another down, and one scampered off to the east exit.
ja: ティタニア: また一人倒した、で、一人は東の出口に逃げてったわね。
言ったでしょ、ねずみだって。

key: TITANIA: I'm not about to let my mistake spiral into a bigger mess.
en: TITANIA: I'm not about to let my mistake spiral into a bigger mess.
ja: ティタニア: あたしのミスをこれ以上大きな失敗につなげるつもりはないから。

key: So anyone who gets in between me and Amaria is forfeiting their life.
en: So anyone who gets in between me and Amaria is forfeiting their life.
ja: だから、あたしとアマリアの間に立ちはだかる奴は、命を差し出すことになるわよ。

key: TITANIA: You'll be helping, of course.
en: TITANIA: You'll be helping, of course.
ja: ティタニア: もちろん、あんたにも手伝ってもらうけど。

key: TITANIA: Or that's going to be the excuse I use to try and justify relying on you right now.
en: TITANIA: Or that's going to be the excuse I use to try and justify relying on you right now.
ja: ティタニア: っていうのは、今あんたに頼ってることを正当化するための言い訳ってだけかもね。

key: Believe me, I would like nothing more than to run through their entire team myself.
en: Believe me, I would like nothing more than to run through their entire team myself.
ja: 本当は、自分の手だけで連中を全員片づけたいくらいなのよ。

key: But I can't do this alone.
en: But I can't do this alone.
ja: でも、一人じゃ無理なの。

key: I only have Aegislash with me. And as much weight as it pulls, I've been down here too long to have the strength to fight them all myself.
en: I only have Aegislash with me. And as much weight as it pulls, I've been down here too long to have the strength to fight them all myself.
ja: 手元にはギルガルドしかいない。すごく頑張ってくれてるけど、あたしはここに長く閉じ込められすぎてて、一人で全員と戦うだけの力が残ってないの。

key: TITANIA: So I'll be asking some favors from you. We can both resent me for it later.
en: TITANIA: So I'll be asking some favors from you. We can both resent me for it later.
ja: ティタニア: だから、あんたにいくつか頼み事をすることになるわ。後で二人ともあたしを恨めばいいから。

key: TITANIA: Like that machine in the center of the room. It should control the water level.
en: TITANIA: Like that machine in the center of the room.  It should control the water level.
ja: ティタニア: 例えば、部屋の真ん中にあるあの機械。あれが水位を制御してるはずなの。

key: We're stuck unless we get to it, but I don't exactly trust my balance right now.
en: We're stuck unless we get to it, but I don't exactly trust my balance right now.
ja: あそこにたどり着かないと動けないんだけど、今は自分のバランス感覚がまるで信用できなくて。
だから、\PN、あんたの出番よ。

key: TITANIA: That machine in the center of the room should control the water level.
en: TITANIA: That machine in the center of the room should control the water level.
ja: ティタニア: 部屋の真ん中にあるあの機械が、水位を制御してるはずなの。
